request.instructions: List each numeric limit the by-law sets on a building, as a kind and a value in metres. Leave out anything that is not a limit.
request.text:
Harbour Lane by-law, section 4: a building stands at least 3.5 metres from the rear boundary.

Section 5. No building on the lane rises above 9 metres at its eaves, and a roof terrace counts as a storey.

Section 6. The “garden zone” is the land behind the rear building line.
